class.name: UltralightView
class.brief_description: Render HTML, CSS and JavaScript in a Godot TextureRect.
class.description:
An Ultralight web view displayed as a Godot texture. Mouse and keyboard input are forwarded from the Control to the page. The view supports CPU Surface rendering and optional GPU rendering through Godot RenderingDevice.
Give the Control a nonzero size before initialization. For container-managed layouts, set [member lazy] in the scene, connect the page signals, wait for layout, then call [method init_view].
Install JavaScript bindings in [signal on_window_object_ready] on every page load. Reloading or reinitializing the view replaces the document and invalidates its retained JavaScript Callables and pending Promises.

method.name: is_accelerated
method.description: Return whether this view actually uses GPU RenderingDevice. A request through [member accelerated] can fall back to CPU if the device is unavailable or initialization fails.

method.name: get_render_statistics
method.description:
Return rendering statistics. These fields are always present: - [code]accelerated[/code]: actual rendering backend. - [code]sdk_edition[/code], [code]sdk_max_fps[/code]: SDK edition and its frame-rate ceiling; zero means no edition ceiling. - [code]max_render_fps[/code]: requested per-view frame-rate limit. - [code]ultralight_render_us[/code]: Ultralight rendering time in microseconds, shared across all views. - [code]cpu_page_upload_bytes[/code], [code]cpu_mipmap_count[/code], [code]cpu_upload_us[/code]: CPU Surface upload counters for this view. These survive reinitialization.
Only an active accelerated view adds GPU fields: [code]gpu_available[/code], [code]bitmap_upload_bytes[/code], [code]geometry_upload_bytes[/code], [code]state_upload_bytes[/code], [code]draws[/code], [code]batches[/code], [code]feedback_copies[/code], [code]render_passes[/code], [code]rd_record_us[/code], [code]gpu_us[/code] and [code]gpu_draws_by_shader[/code]. GPU counters cover all views. Zero GPU timing can mean timestamps are unavailable. GPU mode can still upload SDK resource bitmaps, including Canvas content.
CPU, uninitialized and fallback views omit GPU fields. Rendering preparation timings exclude JavaScript execution outside the render call and do not represent total application frame time.

method.name: set_html_content
method.description: Set [member html] and load the inline HTML immediately if initialized.

method.name: get_html_content
method.description: Return the configured inline [member html].

method.name: set_html_url
method.description: Set [member htmlUrl]. A nonempty URL loads immediately if initialized; an empty URL does not navigate.

method.name: get_html_url
method.description: Return the configured [member htmlUrl]. This is the source property, not a query of the current navigation URL.

method.name: set_transparent
method.description: Set [member transparent]. Call [method init_view] to apply it to an existing view.

method.name: get_transparent
method.description: Return the configured [member transparent] value.

method.name: set_lazy
method.description: Set [member lazy]. Set it in the scene before the node becomes ready to defer automatic initialization.

method.name: get_lazy
method.description: Return the configured [member lazy] value.

method.name: set_accelerated
method.description: Set the requested [member accelerated] mode. Call [method init_view] to apply it to an existing view.

method.name: get_accelerated
method.description: Return the requested [member accelerated] mode. Use [method is_accelerated] for the active backend.

method.name: set_max_render_fps
method.description: Set [member max_render_fps]. This applies immediately and survives view reinitialization.

method.name: get_max_render_fps
method.description: Return the configured [member max_render_fps].

method.name: init_view
method.description:
Create or recreate the Ultralight view using the Control size and current configuration. Width and height must both be greater than zero. Resizing an already initialized Control resizes the page automatically.
Reinitialization destroys the previous document, bindings and JavaScript state. A nonempty [member html] takes precedence over [member htmlUrl] during initialization. Connect [signal on_window_object_ready] before calling this method.

method.name: bind_func
method.description:
Expose [param callback] as a JavaScript function named [param funcName] on [code]window[/code]. Bind it in [signal on_window_object_ready] for each document.
Arguments and return values are converted through Godot Variant: - JavaScript [code]undefined[/code] and [code]null[/code] map to Nil. - Booleans, strings and numbers map to [bool], [String] and [float]. JavaScript numbers are doubles. - Arrays and enumerable object properties map recursively to [Array] and [Dictionary]. - JavaScript functions map to [Callable]. Their lifetime is tied to the document.
Godot arrays and dictionaries returned to JavaScript become new JavaScript containers. Godot objects become object proxies. Object conversion includes enumerable prototype properties. Container cycles and nesting deeper than 64 levels are rejected. Godot string conversion truncates embedded NUL characters, including dictionary keys.

method.name: bind_object
method.description:
Expose [param instance] as [code]window[propertyName][/code]. Install the binding in [signal on_window_object_ready] for each document.
The default compatibility mode allows direct member access, including ordinary public C# properties without [code][Export][/code].
With [param query_members] enabled, [code]Object.keys()[/code] enumerates Godot property metadata, and [code]in[/code] and [code]Reflect.has()[/code] also recognize methods. Queries do not invoke getters. Categories, groups, subgroups and internal metadata entries are excluded. C# properties require [code][Export][/code] in this mode. Objects returned from callbacks or nested containers keep compatibility mode.
The binding exposes the object's Godot API. Use a dedicated adapter object when only a selected application API should be reachable. Freed objects no longer expose their Godot members.

method.name: execute_script
method.description:
Evaluate [param script] in the current page and return its converted result. Return Nil when the view is uninitialized, or when JavaScript evaluation or conversion fails; failures are reported in the Godot error log. Nil can also be a valid JavaScript null or undefined result.
[codeblock] var title = view.execute_script("document.title") [/codeblock]

method.name: fire_key_event
method.description: Forward a keyboard event to an initialized page. Normal Control input forwards key events while the web view has focus.

method.name: fire_mouse_event
method.description: Forward a mouse event to an initialized page. [param position] uses coordinates local to the web view, in pixels. Pass [code]MOUSE_BUTTON_NONE[/code] for motion, a mouse button with [param is_pressed] for press/release, or a wheel button for scrolling. The Control normally forwards its own GUI input automatically.

method.name: on_update_frame
method.description: Internal lifecycle callback. Publishes the rendered texture after Godot drawing. It is connected automatically; applications should not invoke it.

method.name: on_resized
method.description: Internal lifecycle callback. Resizes an initialized page to match the Control. It is connected automatically; applications should not invoke it.

members.member: Inline HTML. Setting it on an initialized view loads the content immediately. A nonempty value takes precedence over [member htmlUrl] when [method init_view] runs.
Page URL. Project resources use URLs such as [code]file:///ui/index.html[/code]; HTTPS pages are also supported. Set a nonempty URL to navigate an initialized view.
Enable a transparent page background. Configure before [method init_view]. Changing it on an existing view requires reinitialization.
Defer automatic initialization when the node becomes ready. Set in the scene when layout or application setup must complete first, then call [method init_view] with a nonzero Control size.

Request GPU rendering through Godot RenderingDevice. Configure before [method init_view]. Compatibility, headless and unavailable devices use CPU Surface rendering. Use [method is_accelerated] to check the actual backend. Reinitialization reloads the page.

Limit this view's animation and repaint rate. Changes apply immediately and survive [method init_view]. Zero removes the per-view limit; the SDK edition ceiling still applies (60 FPS for the public Free edition). Godot frame limits and VSync are independent.

signal.name: on_window_object_ready
signal.description: Emitted when the main frame receives a fresh JavaScript window object. Install functions and object bindings here before page scripts execute. This happens again after navigation or reload.

signal.name: on_dom_ready
signal.description: Emitted when Ultralight reports that a document is ready. Use it for DOM-dependent JavaScript. It is not a guarantee that asynchronous requests and all external images have finished loading.
